SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, h.flight_id, c.charge_id, c.state FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id = h.booking_id LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id WHERE b.status = 'pending'

SELECT b.booking_id, b.request_id, b.amount_cents, h.flight_id, c.charge_id, c.idempotency_key, c.state, ce.kind FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id = h.booking_id LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id LEFT JOIN customer_events ce ON b.request_id = ce.request_id WHERE b.status = 'pending'

SELECT pl.idempotency_key, pl.booking_id, pl.state, pl.final_state, c.charge_id, c.state as charge_state FROM provider_ledger pl LEFT JOIN charges c ON pl.idempotency_key = c.idempotency_key WHERE pl.booking_id IN ('bkg_e8732346a8c459e7bf1da467f87149c2', 'bkg_ea3f800d8dc059bfbc797be464047179', 'bkg_dd3c8ff9bc385c08bbf1a2becf46e5de')
